contract: Current-process handle only, borrowed owned quantized-buffer ranges, flags0, no data mutation or required correctness dependency. API is a best-effort hint, chiefly useful for paged-out memory; fresh zero allocations may receive no benefit. Cached prefetched pages are not immediately reflected in working set, so process counters alone cannot prove physical-cache cost. Only ranges consumed by unchanged full scans are requested. No settings, privileges, working-set limit setters, page eviction, memory lock or external-process access.
ABI: Win64 repr(C) range pointer+usize=16bytes; basic PROCESS_MEMORY_COUNTERS has2u32+8usize=72bytes. Kernel32 imports, current-process memory info only. Native ability checks layouts/return codes and full owned byte guards.
